title: Scalar tensor transport on flat K-flat representatives
statement: With the prime, finite fields E,L, coefficient embedding, scheme X, tensor presentations a,b and normalized ordinary and derived scalar isomorphisms t,e of [lem-trf-integral-scalar-ordinary-model-comparison], construct scalarTensorTransport explicitly: whisker tensorAdjointComparison(a) [new-sf-integral-hom-tensor-adjoint-naturality] by G=pbcDerivedExtend, follow by scalarClosedTensor [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension] transported by e and evaluated on the swapped pair, and follow by the inverse target adjoint comparison. For every pair P,Q of flat-term K-flat complexes over E there are flat-term K-flat termwise G-representatives over L, and the representative comparison for a, followed by scalarTensorTransport at Q(P),Q(Q) and the tensor of the two fixed cochain counits, equals the cochain counit on total(P,Q), then Q of the inverse ordinary scalar tensor total map, then the representative comparison for b [def-sf-compact-support-scalar-tensor-balancing]. This is the representative normalization equation only, not equality of the global natural transformations.

proof.text: On a K-flat pair P,Q compare the presentation adjoint comparison with the canonical reversed tensor representative after Koszul interchange. Test maps into a K-injective I. Hom(P,I) is K-injective; represent maps from Q by chain maps. TensorPresentation.evaluation and coefficientTensorCurry_normalize give the two uncurrying formulas. The interchange contributes exactly the evaluation sign (-1)^(ij). Pure sections and total-summand inclusions detect equality. Injectivity of the Hom equivalences and K-injective resolutions identify the representative comparison. Repeat over L.

Base change preserves flat terms and K-flatness. The pure-section equation for t identifies the ordinary extension units and the ordinary tensor-balancing maps: test them on s tensor (x tensor y), which generate after sheafification. The equality commutes with the signed chain interchange; the two interchange signs cancel. The cochain-counit equation for e identifies the derived counits. Substitute these equations and the preceding representative comparisons into scalarClosedTensorNormalization. Naturality of representative isomorphisms moves the termwise t maps, and inverse-comparison cancellation gives the displayed normalization of scalarTensorTransport on P,Q. No global scalarTensor comparison is asserted here.

theorem scalarTensorTransport_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
    (b : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
    (t : integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X ≅
      completedOrdinaryScalarExtension.{u, u} l E L ι X)
    (e : integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X ≅
      completedDerivedScalarExtension.{u, u} l E L ι X)
    (ht : ∀ (N : integralTowerModules l E X) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X).obj.obj U)
      (x : N.val.obj U),
      (t.hom.app N).val.app U (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X N U s x) =
        completedScalarTensorSection.{u, u} l E L ι X N U s x)
    (he : ∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ,
      e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ completedScalarCounit.{u, u} l E L ι X P =
        (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex t (.up ℤ)).hom.app P))
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ)
    (hp : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P)
    (hq : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q) :
    ∃ (hp' : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X)
          (((pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj P))
      (hq' : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X)
          (((pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj Q)),
      (pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)).map
          ((tensorModel X a).representative.hom.app (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩)) ≫
        (scalarTensorTransport l E L ι X a b e).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
        b.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) P)
          (pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) Q)) =
      pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X)
          (((IntegralHom.totalTensor.{u, u} X
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X)).obj P).obj Q) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (@inv _ _ _ _ (PurCompactSupport.scalarTensorTotal
              (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) P Q)
            (PurCompactSupport.scalarTensorTotal_isIso
              (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) P Q)) ≫
        (tensorModel X b).representative.hom.app (⟨_, hp'⟩, ⟨_, hq'⟩)
